verdict.rationale: Lorikeet's docs describe one agent resolving issues across chat, email, voice, SMS and WhatsApp, which covers chat, email and WhatsApp from the story. In-app messaging, customer-facing Slack and social channels are not documented; the Slack mention applies only to the internal Coach tool, not the customer agent. Missing for 10: in-app channel support, customer-facing Slack channel, social media channels, independent or hands-on corroboration of multichannel deployment.

support.subject: As a support leader, one agent covers chat, email, and in-app, plus the channels my customers actually use — Slack, WhatsApp, social

citations.quote: one agent that resolves issues end-to-end across chat, email, voice and SMS
resolve customer problems end-to-end across their lifecycle - via phone, SMS, chat, email, and WhatsApp
